fields.Name: T369 - Form Builder Canvas Add Section And Element
fields.Description: Exercises the form-builder-canvas mutation path (OnAddSection / OnAddStaticElement producing canvas changes) — the visual form-authoring code, exercised nowhere else.

InputDefinition.goal: In Component Studio → Form Studio, open an existing form (that is not in 'Custom code'/Layout-disabled mode) and switch to the 'Layout' view mode to reveal the drag-and-drop canvas. Verify the canvas renders sections. Click 'Add Section' and confirm a new section appears. In a section header, click one of the add-element buttons (Add static text / Add computed field / Add spacer) and confirm a new element is added to that section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Seeing the canvas accept a new section and a new element (the form becomes dirty / Save enables) is success — you do NOT need to save.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Layout view shows the form-builder canvas with sections and an 'Add Section' control
Clicking 'Add Section' adds a section AND clicking a section's add-element button (static text/computed/spacer) adds an element to that section
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
